description: This file defines functions related to installing Google Maps integrations within a SuiteCRM environment. It registers hooks for various modules such as Prospects, Leads, Contacts, Meetings, Opportunities, Cases, Projects, and Accounts, to handle geocoding and mapping functionalities. It also includes a function to specify custom fields used in these modules, primarily for storing latitude, longitude, address, and geocode status.

methods.name: install_gmaps
methods.description: Installs Google Maps integration by requiring a module installer, installing custom fields, and registering hooks.

methods.name: installJJWHooks
methods.description: Defines hooks for multiple modules for geocoding and relationship management, and registers them via a helper function.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Returns an array of custom field definitions used for geocoding data across various modules.
